title: Codex shell commands cannot reach the network in workspace-write, so npm install and curl fail
symptoms: npm install, pip install, or curl fails with DNS or connection errors inside Codex
Adding network_proxy domain rules does not enable any access
cause: The default workspace-write sandbox keeps command network access off unless sandbox_workspace_write.network_access is true. The network_proxy feature only constrains traffic once access is on; with access off it does nothing.
fix: Set network_access true under sandbox_workspace_write, and add network_proxy rules if you want an allowlist. Some Codex App versions have been reported to ignore the key, so test from the CLI first.
affected: Codex CLI, IDE extension, and ChatGPT desktop app, workspace-write mode, as of 2026-10
